Definition: from G2170; gratitude; actively, grateful language (to God, as an act of worship):--thankfulness, (giving of) thanks(-giving).
BiblicalUsage: Eucharistía is thanksgiving — gratitude, and the words of thanks themselves. Paul prays that thanksgiving would abound, and he tells the Colossians to abound in it with thanksgiving. It is the sound of a people who know they have been given everything.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe eucharistía is the mark of a healthy church: where thanksgiving abounds, complaining starves. I hold that the more I thank God, the more I notice what He has done.
